build_VCTModule: build a PyTorch Lightning module wrapping a VCTPipeline model with configurable optimizer and scheduler
run_training_step: run a training step computing weighted combined distortion and rate loss with PSNR metrics
run_validation_step: run a validation step logging distortion loss, rate loss, and PSNR for video compression
run_test_step: run a test step that compresses and decompresses video then logs PSNR and bits per pixel
review_rate_loss: review the rate_loss method that computes bits per pixel from rate arguments for video frames
